cohort: 631 women with singleton pregnancies, identified as being at high risk for early-onset pre-eclampsia (delivery <= 33 + 6 weeks).
finding: Treatment of high-risk women with low-dose aspirin (LDA) was associated with a greater reduction in uterine artery pulsatility index (UtA-PI), suggesting a positive effect on placental perfusion, despite not affecting placental growth.
mod_finding: A higher rate of Cesarean delivery was observed in the low-dose aspirin (LDA) group.
